name: University of Manchester
summary: A large research university in Manchester, north-west England; about 300 undergraduate courses for 2027 entry, with IB offers of 30–39 points.

ib.text: Typical offers are 30–39 points with three HL subjects (HL 7 counts as an A-level A*). Some courses, e.g. Maths, Chemical Engineering and Computer Science, accept only HL Maths: Analysis and Approaches.

dates.label: UCAT (Medicine, Dentistry): last day to sit the test
UCAS deadline for Medicine and Dentistry, 18:00 UK time
UCAS equal consideration deadline (all other courses), 18:00 UK time

notes: International fees for 2027 were not yet on course pages in September 2026.
Manchester can raise the international fee by up to 7% each year after your first year.
Most courses need no admissions test; BSc Mathematics, for example, states none for 2027 entry but asks 37 points with 7,6,6 at HL.
